# JSON Tree Visualizer

A simple and interactive tool to visualize JSON data as a dynamic tree using React Flow. Paste any JSON and explore its structure with connected, collapsible nodes.

**Live Demo**: [json-tree-visualizer-chi.vercel.app](https://json-tree-visualizer-chi.vercel.app)

## Features

* Visualize any JSON as a node-based graph
* Auto-generated tree layout
* Smooth zoom and pan controls
* Color-coded nodes for objects, arrays, and values
* Lightweight and responsive UI

## Tech Stack

* React + TypeScript
* React Flow for graph rendering
* Next.js (App Router)
* Tailwind CSS

## Usage

1. Paste your JSON data into the input area
2. Click "Visualize" to generate the tree
3. Use mouse to pan and scroll to zoom
4. Click on nodes to explore nested structures

✨ Built to make complex JSONs easy to understand.
